scope: Source review of legacy callbacks; normal immediate-ready/no-error path, callback counts not elapsed time
legacy_direct_send: n/4+10 callbacks for aligned n4..1024, plus up tobudget-1 extra reads at each of2busy polls
queue_checked_send: n/4+12 callbacks, includes duplicate nondestructive RX precheck; no delayedduplicate proof

fixed_reply_receive.decode: CPU-only strict8byte envelope, not copied1024bytepacket/received-length proof

ownership_obligations: Private packet copy across yields, one active owner/session over entire link epoch
Record commit attempt before TXbusy write; failure may have applied, never retry
Error/cancel poisons transport and preserves attempted state; no drain or automatic reset
Future resumable RX must hold software slot/pointer lease over yields, validate before exactlyoncepop; old acquire/release callbacks cannot be treated as one MMIO operation
No target/hardware epoch qualification or hungAXI containment from identity/emptyqueue/poll counts
